annotations.title: Call a REST API from its OpenAPI document

description: Turn a public OpenAPI document into tools you can call, or call one of its endpoints (action list_tools only reads the document; action call sends the request). A call sends the HTTP method the document declares, including POST, PUT or DELETE, to that public API without credentials, so it can change data there. Use when the API you need has an OpenAPI document but no MCP server. Example arguments: {"spec_url": "https://api.example.org/openapi.json", "action": "list_tools"} Ads: this free answer carries one item labelled "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` field (an array with one object), the same array in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]`, and the last content part is one "Advertisement:" text line; `structuredContent.text` never holds it. It never changes the results and cannot be turned off.

action.description: Action: 'list_tools' to discover executable tools, 'call' to invoke an endpoint.

base_url.description: Optional override for API base URL.

spec_url.description: URL of the OpenAPI/Swagger JSON specification.

tool.description: Tool name to execute when action='call'.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: adapt_rest

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

direct_only.description: Matches the gateway does not run (connection_available false, with connection_reason and the provider's direct_endpoint when public). Never a recommendation to call through this server.

sponsored.description: One item labelled Advertisement, after and apart from the results: label, advertiser, title, text, url and a `disclosure` object (paid_placement and house say whether an advertiser paid or it is an AgentValCon house advertisement). Advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.
